description: Use when an agent must confirm a transaction or payment landed: did it succeed, who paid whom, how much of which token. Input: hash; chain (base default, ethereum, arbitrum, monad). Output: JSON status (success/reverted), block+time, confirmations, from, to, native value, fee, decoded ERC-20 transfers with symbol and amount (first 25). Unknown or unmined hash: 404, not charged. Example: ?hash=0x284f8abed91b5631ee28bdb1ccfe78374e18c480cb2ab25f28e3bfac5210fe0b Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

hash.description: Transaction hash on the chosen chain (0x + 64 hex). Unknown or not yet mined → 404 (not charged)

name: base_tx
title: EVM transaction receipt on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Monad: status, decoded ERC-20 transfers, fee, confirmations
